item.title: GPT and Claude go to heraldry school
item.content:encoded: I photographed a mystery coat of arms on vacation and asked a handful of AI models to identify it. Their reasoning traces show the difference between a model that backtracks and one that doubles down.

item.title: Inserting State Transitions in Postgres
item.content:encoded: An append-only status model gives you full history, but concurrent transitions can produce contradictory records. Here's how to prevent that.
